turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling support, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my order last week and I am not happy about it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry about that. Can I get your order number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it is 48213. I want one of the charges refunded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. I can see the duplicate charge, I have refunded it now. It will show up in three to five days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, as long as the money comes back. Thanks.
